name: engagement_level
input_text: A short sequence of crops of one shopper at a shelf, in time order. Faces are blurred.
instructions: How engaged is this shopper with the products on this shelf?

levels.label: passing
levels.description: Walking past without slowing or looking at the shelf.

levels.label: glancing
levels.description: Looks at the shelf briefly while moving; no stop.

levels.label: browsing
levels.description: Stops at the shelf and scans products, may touch one.

levels.label: comparing
levels.description: Holds or inspects two or more products, reads labels or compares them.
